summary: Ubuntu 13.10 (Saucy Salamander) was released on 17 October 2013. Features: Smart Scopes refined and privacy options added, LibreOffice 4.1, MIR display server in development (not default). Touch-friendly improvements. 'Saucy' hinted at boldness; salamander suggested adaptability.
notes: Unsupported since 2014-07-17. Kernel 3.11. Mir was planned as a Wayland alternative; Canonical later abandoned it in favor of Wayland.
